name: Shops at Greenwood
summary: Shops at Greenwood is a neighborhood retail center in Warwick, Rhode Island, professionally managed by the Carpionato Group. This highly-rated shopping destination offers convenient access and quality retailers for the local community.
demographics: Shops at Greenwood serves the Warwick, Rhode Island community, attracting middle to upper-middle income families and professionals from the surrounding suburban neighborhoods. The trade area draws primarily from local residents seeking convenient shopping for everyday needs, with a customer base that values accessibility and quality service. Typical visitors include working professionals, families with children, and retirees who appreciate the center's neighborhood-oriented retail mix and easy parking access.
description: Shops at Greenwood is a well-maintained retail center located at 545 Greenwich Avenue in Warwick, Rhode Island, developed and managed by the prestigious Carpionato Group. This neighborhood shopping destination has earned an impressive 4.8-star rating from visitors who appreciate its convenient location and quality tenant mix. As part of the Carpionato Group's diverse portfolio of retail properties throughout Rhode Island, Shops at Greenwood benefits from professional property management and a commitment to creating exceptional shopping experiences. The center operates with extended hours from early morning until late evening, providing maximum convenience for busy shoppers in the Warwick community. With its strategic location on Greenwich Avenue, the property serves as an accessible retail hub for local residents and visitors seeking a comfortable, well-curated shopping environment.
